description: seed.status reads every set's status (or one, scoped by set) with zero writes — the same read the seed_status tool calls, the same engine either caller asks (S43-extra T6, SD10). The result is the field-for-field twin of the engine's status rows, spoken as string values on the wire: a set's class, its available and applied versions, and each record's state (absent | applied | removed | diverged | retired | failed), version and reason.
